remarks: Location Location! PERFECT RENTAL CONDO FOR YEAR ROUND LIVING OR WEEKEND GETAWAY! MOVE IN READY! This 2 BD 2.5 BA unfurnished OR furnished unit sited in a quiet setting is just 1/2 mile from downtown Westport. Living Room with 9' Vaulted ceiling and fireplace opens to private slate patio and yard w outside lighting, perfect for outside dining and entertaining and gardening. Open concept kitchen (fully equipped/dishes), Bertazzoni gas range w/ light and airy dining room make entertaining easy. The 2 Bedrooms w/full baths and walk in closets, in-unit washer and dryer, and Central Air, make this a carefree home! Complete with attached 2 car tandem garage with entry to condo, storage area and Guest parking. Plenty of Storage space. Walk to downtown to enjoy the restaurants, shopping, outdoor concerts, library, galleries, theaters, riverfront walking trails. Available 9/20/26. Less than 3 miles from Longshore Park Golf/pool/tennis/marina/sailing/kayaking, Compo Beach, Westport Playhouse, Theater, Library, Levitt Pavilion, YMCA, Train, Rowing Club, 2 Yacht Clubs. Easy access to Merritt Parkway, I-95, RR Station .... just 55 miles from NYC.
